notes: Rows 63 (Hex-EtAc) include two separate 25 Â°C entries in the source table; both are preserved with entry_index_at_same_temperature 1 and 2.

Abbreviations resolved to CAS keys include ETG=ethylene glycol, FA=formamide, HeOH=1-hexanol, and Xylene=mixed xylenes.
